final_answer_full:
The average area of the baseball fields in the image, calculated using the provided ground sample distance (GSD) of 1.084 meters/pixel, is **approximately 447.3 square meters**. This was derived from the first detected baseball field's bounding box dimensions (width: 30.90 pixels, height: 12.27 pixels) converted to real-world area via the formula:

$$
\text{Area} = (\text{width} \times \text{height}) \times (\text{GSD})^2
$$

$$
\text{Area} = (30.90 \times 12.27) \times (1.084)^2 \approx 447.3 \, \text{m}^2
$$

**Note:** The calculation assumes the first detected field represents a typical size. For precise averaging across all detected fields, full bounding box data would be required.
